comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: As with all transmutation alchemy recipes, there is a % of success/failure dependent on your alchemy ranks and other factors. You can raise it slightly by using extra materials; alternatively, you can use a Book of Uroboros (UWC item -- very expensive) to get a 100% success rate for one recipe production.
